records.text: If Turning Point and those Charlie (Charlie Kirk) left in charge—if Turning Point and those who Charlie (Charlie Kirk) left in charge failed to stay true to the principles and purposes on which Charlie (Charlie Kirk) founded it and with which he and Candace originally breathed life into it during its formative years—then Turning Point will end up like MySpace.
records.speaker: Candace Owens
